workflow.track: search/reference workflow, not replacement sales page
workflow.title: Compare your installed Mac apps before and after a migration
workflow.primaryIntent: Make an app/version checklist across Macs without confusing metadata snapshots with app or document backups.
workflow.description: BackApp documents JSON app inventories and missing/version-difference comparisons. Use them as a migration checklist, not a binary backup or proof that apps and their data were restored.
outline: Lead with the inventory-versus-backup boundary and official comparison screenshot.
Define inventory scope: normal app folders and optional system inclusion; record permissions and app version context.
Describe documented named snapshot/export/import and comparison states, explicitly not a hands-on test.
Explain why Same version is not proof of data, settings, licence or runtime equivalence; review JSON device/app metadata before sharing.
Separate installed-app differences from running app/helper resource use; introduce the labeled Breathing Room example view.
Give a non-destructive decision checklist: missing app, different version, lost document, storage growth are different jobs.
Keep installation section blocked until compiled minimum OS is resolved; disclose both products' signing/runtime limits.
workflow.interactionPass: Propose a static decision aid: need app/version list → inventory; need app binaries/documents/settings → independent backup plan; need current helper activity/storage investigation → separate maintenance workflow. No uploads, filesystem access or fake calculator.
advantages: BackApp directly documents named JSON inventories and cross-Mac app/version comparison.
Its documented inventory workflow can operate locally; App Store detail lookup is optional online enrichment.
tradeOffs: Snapshot schema is metadata, not a full backup or automated reinstall guarantee.
App-folder scope is bounded; version equality does not establish successful migration.
Compiled OS minimum/architectures unverified and signing caveat must remain visible.
workflow.recommendation: At most one disclosed arc: Breathing Room, which we build, addresses storage and running-helper questions; choose BackApp for the documented inventory comparison job. Do not call one better overall.
